zh:
没有需要清理的项目。

默认配置不写注册表、不建文件，这次检查也没有找到任何与本程序相关的记录。
en:
Nothing to remove.

The default configuration writes no registry value and no file, and this check found no record of the program anywhere.

zh: 启动开关记录（任务管理器）
程序本体未被删除。要卸载，直接删除 ExplorerF11.exe 即可。
en: The program itself was not deleted. To uninstall, simply delete ExplorerF11.exe.

zh:
将删除本程序留下的全部可清理残留：

  · 设置键 HKCU\Software\ExplorerF11
  · 开机自启项，以及任务管理器为它记的启动开关
  · 日志文件
  · Windows 为它记的托盘图标、兼容性、应用名、启动次数与预读取条目

程序本体不会被删除，本程序继续运行；下次启动回到全部默认设置。
确定继续？
en:
Every removable residue of this program will be deleted:

  - settings key HKCU\Software\ExplorerF11
  - the autostart entry and the startup flag Task Manager kept for it
  - the log file
  - the tray icon, compatibility, friendly-name, launch-count and Prefetch records Windows kept for it

The exe is not deleted and the tool keeps running; the next start is back to defaults.
Continue?

zh: 对所有已打开的窗口应用
新建选项卡时重新加速窗口
en: Re-accelerate the window on new tabs

zh:
无法向 Shell 注册事件通知，因此本程序收不到窗口事件，也就无法工作。

请注销后重新登录，然后再运行一次。
en:
Could not register for shell event notifications, so the tool receives no window events and cannot work.

Sign out and back in, then run it again.

zh: — 让 Windows 11 资源管理器变快

（无参数）        在托盘运行，自动加速之后打开的文件夹窗口
  --install         在托盘运行，并勾选开机自启
  --uninstall       只删除开机自启项，其他一切不动
  --status          打印完整残留报告；退出码 0 = 干净，1 = 有可清理项
  --clean, --purge  删除全部可清理残留后退出（会先关闭正在运行的实例）
  --menu            把托盘菜单按文本打印出来（供测试与排查）
  --lang <tag>      本次运行的界面语言（zh/zh-Hant/en/ja/ko）
  --log             把运行日志写到 %TEMP%\ExplorerF11.log
  --no-initial      不处理本次启动前已经打开的窗口
  --quiet           不弹任何对话框（脚本用）
  --version, -v     打印版本号
  --help, -h        打印这段说明
en:
(none)            run in the tray, accelerate folder windows opened later
  --install         run in the tray and tick "Start with Windows"
  --uninstall       remove the autostart entry only, nothing else
  --status          print the full residue report; exit 0 = clean, 1 = residues
  --clean, --purge  remove every removable residue, then exit (closes a running copy)
  --menu            print the tray menu as text (tests and troubleshooting)
  --lang <tag>      UI language for this run (zh/zh-Hant/en/ja/ko)
  --log             write %TEMP%\ExplorerF11.log
  --no-initial      leave windows that were already open alone
  --quiet           never show a message box (for scripts)
  --version, -v     print the version
  --help, -h        print this help

zh:
语言：--lang 优先，其次环境变量 EXPLORERF11_LANG，再次托盘菜单里的选择，
      最后跟随系统语言。托盘里的选择会被保存；选回系统语言即删除保存值。

残留：默认配置不写注册表、不建文件。只有把某个开关改成非默认值、勾选
      开机自启或切换界面语言时才会写入，改回默认即删除。--status 列出
      全部可能位置（含 Windows 自动记录的那些），--clean 清零。
      界面里的清理入口只有一处：残留报告窗口底部的「清理残留…」，执行前会再确认。
      程序本体不算残留；要卸载，直接删除 ExplorerF11.exe 即可。

单位：加速以窗口为单位，不以选项卡为单位 —— F11 由窗口框架处理，一次往返对
      该窗口内的全部选项卡同时生效，选项卡不会单独加速。状态行括号里是这些
      窗口当前包含的选项卡数。

示例：
  ExplorerF11.exe --install              安装，并在登录时启动
  ExplorerF11.exe --status --lang en     用英文核对残留
  ExplorerF11.exe --clean --quiet        在脚本里静默清空全部残留
en:
Language: --lang first, then EXPLORERF11_LANG, then the choice made in the tray
      menu, then the system language. The tray choice is stored; picking the
      system language again deletes the stored value.

Residue: the default configuration writes no registry value and no file. A
      value appears only when a setting leaves its default, when autostart is
      ticked, or when the UI language is switched; returning to the default
      deletes it. --status lists every possible location (including the ones
      Windows records on its own), --clean zeroes them. The only clean entry in
      the UI is the "Clean residues…" button in the residue report; it asks first.
      The exe is not a residue: delete ExplorerF11.exe yourself for a full uninstall.

Unit: acceleration is counted in windows, not in tabs - F11 is handled by the
      window frame, so one round trip covers every tab in that window at once,
      and a tab is never accelerated on its own. The bracketed figure is how many
      tabs those windows currently hold.

Examples:
  ExplorerF11.exe --install              install, and start at logon
  ExplorerF11.exe --status --lang en     check the residue in English
  ExplorerF11.exe --clean --quiet        clear everything silently from a script

zh:
已删除开机自启项。

程序本体与其他残留都还在。要全部清除，运行：
    ExplorerF11.exe --clean
en:
Autostart entry removed.

The exe and the remaining residues are still there. To clear everything, run:
    ExplorerF11.exe --clean

zh: 已禁用（曾由任务管理器关闭）
运行中，等待文件夹窗口
en: running, waiting for a folder window

zh: 本程序；仅当某个开关被改成非默认值时才写入
en: this program, and only while a setting differs from its default

zh: 本程序；你在托盘菜单里勾选「开机自启」时
en: this program, when "Start with Windows" is ticked in the tray menu

zh: 一个 REG_SZ 值：带引号的 exe 完整路径，不带任何参数。取消勾选即删除
en: one REG_SZ value: the quoted full path to the exe, with no arguments. Unticking deletes it

zh: 本程序；只有带 --log 参数或排查问题时
默认不存在。超过 1 MB 从头重写，不会无限增长。清理时删除
en: not created by default; rewritten past 1 MB, so it cannot grow without bound

zh: 你；这个文件是你放到这里的
en: you; the file is where you put it

zh: 这是程序本身，不是残留；清理不会删除它。要卸载，直接删除此文件。
en: this is the program itself, not a residue; cleanup never deletes it. To uninstall, delete this file.

zh: 12 字节 REG_BINARY。首字节为奇数 = 在任务管理器里关过；清理时删除
en: 12-byte REG_BINARY; an odd first byte = disabled in Task Manager. Deleted with the residues

zh: 每个托盘图标一条记录（含 1–3 KB 图标快照）；只统计指向本程序的那些
en: one record per tray icon (a 1-3 KB icon snapshot); only entries pointing at this exe count

zh: Windows 在程序运行后留下的一条「它运行过」的记录，供兼容性判断使用
en: one "this program ran" record Windows keeps for compatibility decisions

zh: 任务管理器、防火墙等界面里显示的程序名就缓存在这里
en: where Task Manager and the firewall get the name they display

zh: 值名是 ROT13 编码的 exe 路径，记录启动次数与最后使用时间
en: value names are ROT13-encoded exe paths; stores launch count and last-used time

zh: 只有管理员可读。存在即说明系统预读过它；清理需要管理员权限
en: administrators only; its presence means the system prefetched it. Cleanup needs elevation

zh: 本程序；写在资源管理器窗口的属性里
en: this program, as a property on explorer windows

zh: 不落盘：explorer 重启或注销后自动消失，无需清理
en: never touches disk: gone when explorer restarts or you sign out

zh: 个可能位置，分 3 组；逐项列出检查结果，不存在的位置同样列示。
en: possible locations in 3 groups; every one is listed below with its result, present or absent.

zh: 结论：干净 —— 系统里找不到任何与它相关的记录（0 项需要清理）。
en: Verdict: clean - no residue of it anywhere (0 items to remove).

zh: 标注「可清理」的项目会被窗口里的「清理残留…」删除；程序本体不删除。
en: Items marked "removable" are deleted by "Clean residues…" in this window; the exe is not.

zh:
注 1：注册表本身还有固定开销（每个键约 1 KB，每个值还有名称与头部开销），这里只统计值数据与名称的字节数。
注 2：Windows 自动记录的那几项删掉之后，下次运行还会重新生成 —— 这是系统行为，不属于本程序留下的残留。
注 3：本报告只读：生成报告不会修改任何一项；「清理残留…」按钮是唯一的删除入口，执行前会再确认一次。
en:
Note 1: the registry adds fixed overhead (about 1 KB per key, plus per-value headers); only value data and names are counted here.
Note 2: items recorded by Windows come back on the next run - that is OS behaviour, not a residue left by this program.
Note 3: this report is read-only: generating it changes nothing. The "Clean residues…" button is the only place that deletes, and it asks first.

zh: 可能的值是 Tabs、InitialSweep、Language。改回默认即删该值，键空则删键
en: possible values: Tabs, InitialSweep, Language; a value is deleted when it returns to its default

zh: 启动时加速已打开的窗口
